# 🚀 Full-Stack Web Development Roadmap
# 全栈 Web 开发学习路线图

**Tech Stack 技术栈**: React (Frontend 前端) + Go (Backend 后端)

---

## 📅 Day 1: Environment Setup & Core Concepts
## 📅 第1天：环境搭建与核心概念

### Learning Objectives 学习目标
| English | 中文 |
|---------|------|
| Set up development environment | 搭建开发环境 |
| Understand full-stack architecture | 理解全栈架构 |
| Basic Git workflow | 基础 Git 工作流 |

### Content 内容


### Tasks 任务

```bash
# 1. Install Go 安装 Go
# https://go.dev/doc/install
go version

# 2. Install Node.js & npm 安装 Node.js
# https://nodejs.org/
node -v
npm -v

# 3. Install VS Code extensions 安装 VS Code 扩展
# - Go (by Google)
# - ES7+ React/Redux/React-Native snippets
# - Prettier - Code formatter

# 4. Initialize Git repository 初始化 Git 仓库
git init
```
